title: Comprehensive Test — Chapter 2: Solving Linear Inequalities

questions.prompt: Which inequality symbol means 'at least'?
Translate: 'A number x is greater than -8 and less than or equal to 4' as a compound inequality: $ -8 $ ___ $ x \le 4 $.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The inequality is $ -8 < x \le 4 $, so the blank is <.

questions.prompt: Solve $ x - 6 \ge -10 $. What is the boundary number?
Which graph correctly represents $ x > 2 $?
When multiplying or dividing both sides of an inequality by a negative number, you must ___ the inequality symbol.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: You must reverse (flip) the inequality symbol.

questions.prompt: Solve $ 5g - 13 < 2 $. What is the boundary number?
Which absolute value inequality has no solution?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ |x| < -3 $ has no solution because absolute value cannot be less than a negative number.

questions.prompt: By the Addition Property of Inequality, adding the same number to both sides produces an ___ inequality.
A microwave uses 1100 W on a 1800 W circuit. Write an inequality for the additional watts $ w $ you can add without overloading. (e.g., 1100 + w < 1800)
Solve $ -7y \le -35 $. What is the correct inequality?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Dividing by -7 and reversing gives $ y \ge 5 $.

questions.prompt: To solve $ 4|2x - 5| + 1 > 21 $, the first step is to ___ 1 from both sides.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The correct compound inequality is $ 2 < x < 6 $.
questions.prompt: Which compound inequality represents 'a number is less than 6 and greater than 2'?

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The inequality is $ |x - 664| \le 100 $, so the blank is ≤.
questions.prompt: The absolute deviation of $ x $ from 664 is at most 100. The inequality is $ |x - 664| $ ___ 100.
Solve $ |x + 7| \le 2 $. What is the left endpoint of the solution interval?
If $ |x| > c $ and $ c < 0 $, what is the solution?

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Both inequality symbols must be reversed.
questions.prompt: When dividing the three-part inequality $ -4 < -2x \le 8 $ by -2, you must reverse ___ inequality symbols.
You earn $9.50 per hour and need $247. What is the minimum whole number of hours you must work?
Solve $ 6x - 5 < 2x + 11 $. What is the solution?
Is -4 a solution of $ -4.5x > -21 $? (yes/no)
Which graph represents $ x \le -3 $?
The solution of $ |ax + b| > c $ is the ___ of two separate inequalities.
After isolating the absolute value in $ 3|d + 1| - 7 \ge -1 $, what is the resulting inequality? (e.g., |d+1| >= 2)
Solve $ -2d - 2 < 3d + 8 $. What is the solution?
Solve $ x - 2 > -9 $. What is the boundary number?
If an inequality simplifies to $ -3 > 12 $, the inequality has ___ solution.
Solve $ |c - 1| \ge 5 $. What is the solution?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The solution is $ c \le -4 $ or $ c \ge 6 $.

questions.prompt: Translate 'A number y is at most 0 or at least 2' into a compound inequality: $ y $ ___ $ 0 $ or $ y $ ___ $ 2 $.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The inequality is $ y \le 0 $ or $ y \ge 2 $, so the blanks are ≤ and ≥.

questions.prompt: What is the extraneous solution of $ |2x + 12| = 4x $?
The mnemonic 'GreatOR' helps remember that a greater than absolute value inequality uses the word ___.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Graphing before solving is not part of the algebraic blueprint.
questions.prompt: Which step is NOT part of the algebraic blueprint for solving inequalities?
options: Simplify by distributing and combining like terms
Collect variable terms on one side
